title: California's Changing Fire Seasons
description: Analyzed NASA MODIS satellite fire detections from 2003–2025 to explore regional and seasonal patterns across California. Developed interactive D3.js visualizations with year-range filtering and linked charts to compare fire detection trends over time.

title: Abortion Care Accessibility in the U.S.
description: Explored abortion care accessibility across U.S. states through contrasting data visualizations. Applied visual storytelling and design principles to demonstrate how different representations of the same data can influence interpretation.

title: Bikewatching: Interactive Bike-Share Map
description: Developed an interactive bike-share map using D3.js and Mapbox to visualize station activity and explore patterns in bike arrivals and departures. Implemented time-based filtering and color-coded markers to highlight changes in station usage throughout the day.

title: Cooking Time and Recipe Rating
description: Investigated whether longer cooking times lead to higher recipe ratings using Food.com data. Applied exploratory data analysis, hypothesis testing, and machine learning to identify patterns and predict recipe ratings.

title: Animal Shelter Outcomes Analysis
description: Analyzed animal shelter data from multiple U.S. cities to investigate factors influencing adoption, transfer, and euthanasia outcomes. Applied data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, and statistical testing to identify patterns in shelter outcomes.

title: Café Lindo: Coffee Business Website
description: Designed and developed a website for a family-owned Guatemalan coffee business using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Created an engaging, responsive layout highlighting the company's history, coffee farms, and products through visual storytelling and interactive design.
